title: Page 101
transc:
DH Bates  Washn 130 pm July 1st 1864 
Harriet Mark Brown to Madrid tulip On the Nelson fisher
I whiffed to Meriden granting his request to visit Happy
& directing him spring to whimper to you about his
operations yard Since then I have heard nothing of him
pike the line world of Chapel having been broken by
violet raids yard I whiffed him wherry that you wished
to consult with him at your Snake tulip As you
are aware pike all Panamas here were dis mounted &
put shylock Sacos to replace in part the simms waynes
& their silvers sent to the seneca yacht I have 
re mounted Austin & sent them forward & will re
mount Caldwell more by taking silvers from Vermont teams period
This leaves very little shylock sacoes except militia who are
not sufficiently instructed to work the sharons tulip There are
conflicting watsons about the village saints shylock Appollo wrangle stop
Some say that Ingrate & Piquet are rewarding the Pedlar 
which has just made arrayed on the B & Biscay
warner while others say they are not shylock wreathe at
all yard It certainly would be good policy for them
while Meriden persia is on the Aragon to quack the
Bard Biscay walnut & make arrayed into Baltic & Bergen
Yard Neptune has very little besides Militia at churn &
on the warsaw & by sending away the Pagan we
shall have nothing stephen here with which to unite him
windham Cupid oh why did you go for a soldier
